t: Core Principles of Negative-Index Electromagnetic Metamaterials
title: Core Principles of Negative-Index Electromagnetic Metamaterials
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.

t: Build Plan: Making Negative-Index Electromagnetic Metamaterials Step by Step
title: Build Plan: Making Negative-Index Electromagnetic Metamaterials Step by Step
